priorities.summary: SAP S/4HANA's Manage Substitution/Validation Rules function does not sufficiently validate input processed by its domain-specific scripting language, letting an authenticated attacker run arbitrary code. Apply SAP's October security notes.

Progress MarkLogic Server before 12.1.0 / 11.3.7 lets a remote attacker with query-execution access invoke an XQuery evaluation function without the required privilege, leading to server-side code execution with elevated permissions. Upgrade to 12.1.0 or 11.3.7.
IBM Maximo AI Service 9.1.0 and 9.2.0 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper control of code generation. Update to the patched release.

model.name: Meta Muse Wonder & Muse Wonder Full
model.summary: Meta's new frontier models launched Oct 12, built for personal and professional agentic work with Active Memory (retains context across conversations) and Active Focus (sustains multi-step tasks, recovers from errors). Muse Wonder ships via the Meta Model API and Muse Code; the stronger Wonder Full is Muse Code subscribers only. Meta claims state-of-the-art coding and finance/legal agent performance.
